panels.title: Top Direct equity funds by 1y return

targets.rawSql:
select scheme_name, replace(category, 'Equity Scheme - ', '') as category,
       round((ret_1y * 100)::numeric, 2) as "1y return %",
       round((ret_1y_vs_benchmark * 100)::numeric, 2) as "1y vs Nifty 50 (pp)",
       round((cagr_3y * 100)::numeric, 2) as "3y CAGR %",
       round((vol_1y * 100)::numeric, 2) as "1y vol %", round(sharpe_1y::numeric, 2) as "1y Sharpe",
       round((max_drawdown_1y * 100)::numeric, 1) as "1y max drawdown %",
       rank_ret_1y as "rank in category"
from marts.mart_fund_scorecard
where plan = 'Direct' and asset_class = 'Equity Scheme' and ret_1y is not null
order by ret_1y desc
limit 15

select replace(category, 'Equity Scheme - ', '') as category, round((median_ret_1y * 100)::numeric, 2) as "median 1y %"
from marts.mart_category_summary
where plan = 'Direct' and asset_class = 'Equity Scheme' and funds >= 3
order by median_ret_1y desc

select as_of_date::timestamp as time, nav as "UTI Nifty 50 Index (Direct)"
from marts.fct_fund_metrics_monthly
where scheme_code = 120716
order by 1

panels.title: Suspicious NAV moves (>50% in a day)

targets.rawSql:
select nav_date::text as nav_date, scheme_name, fund_house, prev_nav, nav, round((change * 100)::numeric, 1) as "change %"
from marts.mart_nav_anomalies
order by nav_date desc
limit 50
